doc: The values lmcache_local_disk's defaults held until 2026-10-23 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78): an engine with 64 request slots, 2,000 requests per slot to warm and 20,000 measured, 32 MiB chunks (128 KiB per token, an 8B model's), a context of 8,192, 40 conversations open per slot, 50 system prompts of a median 1,500 tokens, ShareGPT's turn lengths, and a pool that keeps nothing of 91% of returning conversations. Placeholders, not measured: no job stands behind them (the traces behind the abstract are the examples sharegpt-chat and agentx-odirect).
